explanation: The theorem says that over a self-injective finite-dimensional algebra, every finitely generated module is Gorenstein projective. Gorenstein projective modules (`IsGorensteinProjective`) and totally acyclic complexes are defined in this library, not in Mathlib. A grep for "Gorenstein" in Mathlib's sources finds only one hit, in `GroupTheory/Focal.lean`, which is unrelated. The proof combines the library's own results on Frobenius categories and on splicing complexes, so no single Mathlib declaration carries its content.
